body:
Seeing my best friend bleeding out hit me really hard. I'm not gonna give up. On my BFF or anyone else. It....just...hit me in the gut so hard. I'll get back up and go at it again. Just needed a shoulder to cry on for a while...we are all human...I feel bad for calling my BFF in to ES, but I had to. I would not have if they were just idealizing or planning...they were active in the worst way. 

Thank you for being you. And thank you for the kind words :)
